versions.changelog:
- Updated service description and offer names from "brand critiques" and "Brand Read" to "brand reviews" and "Brand review"
- Updated MCP server URL to https://sigilbrandstudio.com/mcp
- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- Minor edits for wording consistency and clarity throughout documentation

Initial release of the "sigil" skill.

- Provides brand critiques using Sigil's MCP server with no sign-in required.
- Supports analysis based on a public website and an optional product document.
- Returns a comprehensive brand evaluation: score, verdict, six dimensions, comparative analysis, positioning, visual identity, voice notes, a one-line idea, and prioritized recommendations.
- Simple workflow: start a read, check status, and deliver results with a shareable link.
